# P01 test contract

The P01 tests were written from the spec only. Where API.md, DATA_MODEL.md, INVARIANTS.md and the ADRs do not
name a Python symbol, an HTTP body shape or a log field exactly, the tests assume the choices below. The
implementer builds to this list. If an entry is wrong for a good reason, say so and ask the orchestrator; do not
change the test silently.

Everything marked **doc** comes from a named document and is not an assumption. Everything else is an assumption
made by the tests (marked **assumed**). Tests import symbols late via `tests/factories/contract.py::load`, so a
missing module fails only the tests that need it.

## 1. Python interfaces (module path, symbol, behaviour)

| Module | Symbol | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app.core.ids` | `new_id() -> UUID` | UUIDv7 per RFC 9562 (top 48 bits = unix ms, version 7, RFC 4122 variant). Monotonic within one millisecond (`uuid6.uuid7()` satisfies this). **doc** ADR-005 |
| `app.core.money` | `PaiseAmount` | `Annotated[StrictInt, Field(gt=0, le=2**63-1)]` for Pydantic. Rejects float, integral float, str, bool, None, 0, negatives, > bigint, in python and JSON mode. `Paise = NewType("Paise", int)` also exported. **doc** ADR-005 (type names assumed) |
| `app.core.timeutils` | `plant_today(tz: str, now: datetime \| None = None) -> date` | `now` defaults to the current instant; `ValueError("... timezone ...")` for an unknown IANA name. **assumed** signature |
| `app.core.timeutils` | `month_period(tz: str, year: int, month: int) -> MonthPeriod` | `MonthPeriod(start: date, end: date, start_utc: datetime, cutoff: datetime)`; `cutoff` = (end + 1 day) 00:00 plant-local as a UTC instant (Kolkata, Sep 2026 -> `2026-09-30T18:30:00Z`). **doc** ADR-005 section 3 (names assumed) |
| `app.core.errors` | `AppError(detail: str \| None = None)` base with class attrs `status: int`, `code: str`, `title: str`; attribute `detail` | subclasses (each with the status/code from API.md 1.4): `Unauthenticated` 401 `unauthenticated`, `Forbidden` 403 `forbidden`, `NotFound` 404 `not_found`, `InvalidTransition` 409 `invalid_transition`, `Conflict` 409 `conflict`, `PayloadTooLarge` 413 `payload_too_large`, `UnsupportedMediaType` 415 `unsupported_media_type`, `ValidationFailed` 422 `validation_error`, `InvariantViolation` 422 `invariant_violation`, `IdempotencyMismatch` 422 `idempotency_mismatch`, `RateLimited(retry_after: int, detail=None)` 429 `rate_limited` (header `Retry-After`). **assumed** class names |
| `app.core.errors` | problem+json rendering | `application/problem+json`; fields `type` (= `https://qualloop.in/problems/<code with - for _>`), `title`, `status`, `code`, `detail`, `instance` (request path), `request_id` (= `X-Request-ID` response header), `errors[{field, code, message}]` for validation. `field` is the bare name (`reason`, not `body.reason`). Malformed JSON -> 400 `bad_request`. Unknown route -> 404 `not_found`. Unhandled -> 500 `internal_error` with no stack trace, exception text or SQL. **doc** API.md 1.4 |
| `app.core.errors` | DB error mapping | `DBAPIError` whose `orig` is: `CheckViolation`, `RaiseException`, `IntegrityConstraintViolation` -> 422 `invariant_violation`; `DeadlockDetected`, `SerializationFailure` -> 409 `conflict`; `InsufficientPrivilege` with "row-level security" -> 404 `not_found`; `UniqueViolation` -> 409 or 422 (tests accept either, never 500). SQL text and driver messages are never in the body. **doc** ADR-003, plan 2.3 |
| `app.core.permissions` | `Actor(type, user_id, tenant_id, role, can_approve, plant_ids, session_id=None, ip=None)` | frozen dataclass. `type` in `user`, `supplier_session`, `system`, `ai`. **assumed** field names |
| `app.core.permissions` | `Permission(roles: frozenset[str], requires_can_approve: bool = False, admin_or_can_approve: bool = False)` | `roles` holds `admin`, `quality`, `viewer`. Admin implicitly holds every `quality` permission (A-70). `requires_can_approve` = `+CA` (admin does NOT bypass it). `admin_or_can_approve` = `A or CA`. **doc** API.md 1.3 (names assumed) |
| `app.core.permissions` | `check_permission(permission, actor, *, command: bool) -> None` | raises `Forbidden` when denied. `command=True`: viewer is always denied even if listed. `ai` and `supplier_session` actors are always denied. **doc** ADR-003, ADR-008, INV-AI-02 |
| `app.core.permissions` | `plant_in_scope(actor, plant_id) -> bool` | admin: always; quality/viewer: `plant_id in actor.plant_ids` (empty list = nothing). **doc** A-04 (empty-list reading assumed) |
| `app.core.commands.base` | `all_commands() -> Sequence[Command]` | each `Command` has `name: str`, `method == "POST"`, `path: str` (relative to `/api/v1`, FastAPI `{id}` style), `permission: Permission`. Must include the 6 platform commands of API.md 3.1. Every POST route under `/api/v1` is a registered command or one of: `/auth/login`, `/auth/logout`, `/auth/password-reset/request`, `/auth/password-reset/confirm`, `/files/upload-url`, or `/supplier*`, `/webhooks*`. **assumed** |
| `app.core.commands.state_machine` | `StateMachine(name: str, transitions: Mapping[tuple[str, str], str])` | `.apply(state, command) -> new_state` raises `InvalidTransition` for any pair not in the table (including unknown states); `.allowed(state) -> set[str]`; `InvalidTransition.detail` names the current state; `InvalidTransition` is importable from here and from `app.core.errors`. **doc** ADR-003 |
| `app.core.auth.passwords` | `hash_password(plain) -> str`, `verify_password(hash: str \| None, plain) -> bool` | argon2id with `argon2-cffi` library defaults. `verify_password(None, x)` still performs one `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify` against a dummy argon2id hash and returns False; malformed hash -> False, never raises. **doc** ADR-008, plan edge cases |
| `app.core.db` | `tenant_tx(tenant_id, actor_type="system", actor_id=None)` | context manager yielding a SQLAlchemy `Session`; one READ COMMITTED transaction; `set_config(..., true)` for `app.tenant_id`, `app.actor_type`, `app.actor_id`; commit on success, rollback on exception. **doc** ADR-003/004 |
| `app.core.db` | `read_tx(tenant_id, actor_type="user", actor_id=None)` | same, but the transaction is read only (`psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction` on writes). **assumed** signature |
| `app.core.db` | `current_session() -> Session` | the session of the enclosing request / `tenant_tx` / job; `RuntimeError` outside one. **assumed** |
| `app.core.models` | ORM classes `Plant`, `User` (and `Tenant`) | attributes named like the columns (`id`, `tenant_id`, `name`, `code`, ...). **assumed** class names |
| `app.core.outbox.registry` | `get(event_type) -> EventSpec \| None`, `all_event_types()` | `EventSpec(name, derived: bool, emitters: tuple[str, ...])`. All 19 blueprint 22.3 events registered with `derived=False`; the 7 A-94 platform events with `derived=True`. Platform events have non-empty `emitters` (command/job names); 22.3 events may have none until their phase. **doc** ARCHITECTURE 7, A-94 |
| `app.core.outbox.dispatcher` | `MAX_ATTEMPTS == 5`; `backoff_seconds(attempts: int) -> int` = `5 * 2**attempts`; `message_id_for(event_id, handler_name) -> str` = `f"{event_id}:{handler_name}"` | **doc** ADR-006 |
| `app.core.outbox.dispatcher` | `dispatch_once(*, enqueue: Callable[[ClaimedEvent], None] \| None = None, limit: int = 100) -> DispatchResult` | one cycle: `app_claim_outbox_batch(limit)` (SKIP LOCKED, oldest first); for each claimed row call `enqueue(event)` (default: one Dramatiq message per registered handler); success -> `processed_at = now()`; exception -> `attempts += 1`, `last_error` (<= 4096 bytes, safe for NUL bytes), other rows of the batch unaffected; reaching 5 -> log event `outbox_event_dead_lettered` at level `error` or `critical` with fields `event_id`, `tenant_id`, `attempts` (exactly once). Per-row updates run under that row's tenant GUC. `ClaimedEvent` has `id`, `tenant_id`, `event_id`, `event_type`, `aggregate_type`, `aggregate_id`, `payload`, `attempts`. `DispatchResult` has `processed: int`, `failed: int`. **assumed** names |
| `app.dispatcher` | `run(stop: threading.Event, *, interval: float = 1.0, enqueue=None, limit: int = 100) -> None` | loops `dispatch_once`, survives a failing cycle, returns promptly after `stop` is set. **assumed** |
| `app.core.outbox.sweeper` | `sweep_pending() -> int` | stub, returns 0; registered as Dramatiq actor `core.sweep_pending` on queue `scheduled`. **doc** ADR-006 item 5 |
| `app.scheduler` | `acquire_leader(redis, instance_id) -> bool`, `renew_leader(...) -> bool`, `release_leader(...) -> None` | Redis key `sched:leader`, `SET NX`, TTL 30 s; only the owner renews/releases. **doc** ADR-006 |
| `app.scheduler` | `fan_out(send: Callable[[UUID], None]) -> int` | calls `send(tenant_id)` once per `app_active_tenant_ids()` and returns the count. **doc** ADR-004 table |
| `app.scheduler` | `run(stop, *, instance_id, redis, tick: float, on_leader_tick: Callable[[], None]) -> None` | calls `on_leader_tick` only while it holds the lock; releases the lock on clean stop. **assumed** |
| `app.worker` | `broker` (module global, also `dramatiq.set_broker`), `build_broker(redis_url) -> Broker` | middleware includes `Retries` (min_backoff 10 000 ms, max_backoff 1 800 000 ms), `Prometheus`, a tenant middleware and a dead-letter middleware. Importing `app.worker` registers the platform actors: `files.scan` (queue `ai`), `core.sweep_pending` (queue `scheduled`), the password-reset email actor. `create_app()` must make the same global broker available to the API. **doc** ADR-006/011 |
| `app.worker` (middleware) | tenant context | every message must carry `tenant_id` (valid UUID string) as a keyword argument; otherwise the actor body never runs. The actor body runs inside `tenant_tx(tenant_id, actor_type="system")` and reaches the session through `current_session()`. **doc** ADR-004/006 (kwarg placement assumed) |
| `app.worker` (middleware) | dead letter | a message is dead-lettered after **5 executions in total** (blueprint 22.2 "5 attempts"; stock Dramatiq `max_retries=5` gives 6, so set `max_retries=4` or equivalent). Then: one `job_dead_letters` row under the job's tenant (`queue`, `actor_name`, `message_id` = `Message.message_id`, `event_id` from the `event_id` kwarg if present, `payload` = message kwargs, `attempts` = 5, `last_error` = exception text without traceback, `dead_lettered_at`); `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, message_id) DO NOTHING`; one log line `job_dead_lettered` at `error`/`critical` with `message_id`, `actor_name`, `tenant_id`, `queue`, `attempts`. **doc** ADR-006 item 4, A-89 |
| `app.core.mail` | `send_email(*, to, subject, body, idempotency_key: str) -> None` | `idempotency_key` is keyword-only and required; the SMTP message carries header `X-Idempotency-Key: <key>`; a second call with the same key delivers nothing (Redis `idem:*` or equivalent). SMTP host/port from `QL_SMTP_HOST` / `QL_SMTP_PORT` (mailpit locally). Providers live only here, never imported by the HTTP layer. **doc** INV-PLT-11 (module name assumed) |
| `app.core.files` | `presign_upload(...)`, `presign_download(caller: Actor \| None, key: str, *, expires_in: int \| None = None) -> str` | download: `None` caller -> `Unauthenticated`; `supplier_session` / `ai` actor -> `Forbidden`; key must pass `assert_key_in_tenant` (else `NotFound`, same body as a missing object); object must exist in the **files** bucket (an object only in quarantine -> `NotFound`); viewer allowed only for kinds `ncr` and `report` (else `Forbidden`, A-70); URL is SigV4 with `X-Amz-Expires` <= 900; `expires_in > 900` raises `ValueError` or is clamped; `response-content-disposition` is `attachment` except kind `ncr` (`inline`). **doc** A-92, ADR-011 |
| `app.core.files.storage` | `build_key(tenant_id, kind, object_id, ext) -> str` | `t/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{object_id}/{uuid7}.{ext}`; `ValueError` mentioning "kind" / "extension" for values outside kinds `ncr, doc, evidence, import, report, export` and extensions `pdf, jpg, png, csv, xlsx`. **doc** ADR-011 |
| `app.core.files.storage` | `assert_key_in_tenant(key, tenant_id)` | `NotFound` for another tenant, traversal, absolute path, wrong case, missing `t/`, prefix confusion, NUL bytes, empty. **doc** ADR-004 item 6 |
| `app.core.files.storage` | `validate_upload_request(purpose, content_type, size) -> UploadSpec(kind, ext)` | purposes `ncr_photo` (jpeg/png) -> `ncr`, `document` (pdf/jpeg/png) -> `doc`, `evidence` (pdf/jpeg/png) -> `evidence`, `import` (csv, xlsx) -> `import`; unknown/server-only purpose -> `ValidationFailed`; size <= 0 -> `ValidationFailed`; size over 20 MB -> `PayloadTooLarge`; other type -> `UnsupportedMediaType`. Tests only use sizes below 20 000 000 and above 20 971 520 (MB vs MiB is open). **doc** ADR-011, API.md 1.4 (purpose names assumed) |
| `app.core.files.storage` | `sniff_content_type(data: bytes) -> str \| None`, `declared_matches_content(declared, data) -> bool` | `filetype`-based; executables are never reported as an allowed type. **doc** ADR-011 |
| `app.core.files.scanner` | `scan_bytes(data) -> ScanVerdict(infected: bool, signature: str \| None)` | ClamAV `INSTREAM` (host/port `QL_CLAMAV_HOST` / `QL_CLAMAV_PORT`). |
| `app.core.files.scanner` | `scan_quarantined(tenant_id: UUID, key: str) -> ScanResult(status, reason, sha256)` | `status` is `available` or `quarantined`; `reason` is `content_type_mismatch` or `infected` when quarantined; `sha256` lowercase hex only when available. Promotes by copying quarantine -> files under the same key, then deleting the quarantine copy. Idempotent when redelivered. ClamAV unreachable -> raises (job retries), nothing promoted. Foreign tenant prefix / missing object -> `NotFound`. Registered as actor `files.scan` taking `tenant_id`, `key`. **doc** ADR-011 item 3 |
| `app.core.logging` | `mask_mobile(str) -> str` (`+919876543210` -> `+91******3210`), `mask_email(str) -> str` | and the structlog pipeline masks mobiles/emails found in any field value and redacts fields named `token`, `otp`, `password`, `password_hash`, `authorization`, `cookie`. **doc** ADR-015 |
| `app.core.telemetry` | `init_telemetry(settings) -> bool` | False when `otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint` is empty; True when set. **doc** ADR-015 |
| `seeds.demo` | `DEMO_USERS: dict[str, tuple[str, str]]`, `main()` | keys `admin`, `quality_approver`, `quality`, `viewer` -> `(email, dev_password)`; `python -m seeds.demo` is idempotent (1 tenant, 2 plants, 4 users) and exits non-zero outside `QL_ENV=local`. **assumed** |

## 2. HTTP bodies (API.md leaves them open)

| Endpoint | Request | Response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST /auth/login` | `{email, password}` | 200; sets `ql_session` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/) and `ql_csrf` (Secure, SameSite=Lax, readable by JS). Failures: 401 `unauthenticated`, one identical body for every cause; 429 `rate_limited` after 5 failures / 15 min per email and per IP |
| `POST /auth/logout` | none | 200 or 204; deletes the Redis session; clears cookies; needs CSRF |
| `POST /auth/password-reset/request` | `{email}` | 200/202/204, identical for known, unknown and inactive emails; 429 after 3 per hour per email |
| `POST /auth/password-reset/confirm` | `{email, otp, new_password}` | 200/202/204; wrong, expired, burnt OTP and unknown email give the same 4xx body; `otp` is 6 digits |
| `POST /users` | `{email, name, role, can_approve?, plant_ids?, mobile?}` | 200/201 `{id, email, name, mobile, role, can_approve, plant_ids, active}`; never `password_hash` |
| `POST /users/{id}/update` | `{name?, mobile?, role?, can_approve?, plant_ids?, reason?}` | read model; `reason` required when `role` or `can_approve` changes; `active` cannot be changed here |
| `POST /users/{id}/deactivate` | `{reason}` | read model with `active: false`; deletes the user's Redis sessions after commit |
| `POST /plants` | `{name, code, address?, timezone?}` | `{id, name, code, address, timezone}` |
| `POST /plants/{id}/update` | `{name?, address?, timezone?, reason?}` | read model |
| `POST /tenant/settings/update` | `{settings: <TenantSettings>, reason}` | `{settings}` |
| `GET /tenant/settings` | | `{settings: {sla_hours: {critical: {containment: 24, final: 168}, major: {containment: 48, final: 240}, minor: {containment: null, final: 360}}, default_ppm_target: int > 0, min_sample: {receipts: 5, units: 1000, scars_due: 1}, score_weights: {quality: 50, response: 20, repeat: 15, documents: 15}}}` (blueprint 9 C6, 12.1, 14.1; hours = days x 24) |
| `GET /users`, `GET /plants` | `?limit&cursor` | `{items: [...], next_cursor}`; limit 1-200, default 50; bad cursor 400 `bad_request` |
| `GET /me` | | `{email, name, role, can_approve, plants: [id or {id,...}]}` |
| `POST /files/upload-url` | `{purpose, content_type, size}` | `{key, url, expires_at}`; PUT to the quarantine bucket; `Content-Type` and `Content-Length` are signed |

## 3. Behaviour the tests rely on that no document states exactly

- CSRF: `X-CSRF-Token` must equal the `ql_csrf` cookie and `Origin` must equal `QL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`. Login and password reset are exempt from the token (no session yet) but the tests still send `Origin`.
- Audit rows: `object_type` in `user`, `plant`, `tenant`; `action` is `<object_type>.<verb>` (e.g. `plant.create`); login writes `object_type='user'`, `object_id=<user id>`, `action='auth.login'`; password reset confirm writes an `activity_log` row with `object_type='user'` and an action containing `password`. Create rows have `before IS NULL`.
- IP in `activity_log.ip` is the socket peer (`request.client.host`); `X-Forwarded-For` is not asserted either way.
- `created_by` / `updated_by` of rows written by a command equal the acting user's id.
- Redis keys: `sess:{sha256(token)}`, `user_sessions:{user_id}` (removed when empty), `rl:*` (TTL <= 900 s for login), `otp:*` (value never contains the OTP, TTL <= 900 s), `idem:*`, `sched:leader`, `dramatiq:*`. Raw tokens and raw emails are never part of a key.
- Sessions: idle 8 h sliding and absolute 7 d are evaluated **in Python from timestamps stored in the session record** (so the tests can move the clock with `time-machine`); the Redis TTL is a backstop (<= 8 h).
- Idempotency: `idempotency_keys.endpoint` contains the path; `request_hash` is non-empty; `response_status` / `response_body` are filled when the command completes; `expires_at - created_at` is 24 h +- 5 min; an expired row is ignored; an in-flight duplicate returns 409 `conflict` immediately and never waits (use a non-blocking guard such as `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock` or `NOWAIT`).
- Deactivation kills Redis sessions only after the command's transaction committed.
- `trg_<table>_set_updated_at` / `trg_<table>_append_only` names come from `alembic/helpers.py`; tests rely on `trg_outbox_events_set_updated_at`.
- `trg_append_only` (P00) raises `integrity_constraint_violation` with the text "is append-only".
- `users.plant_ids` trigger raises any psycopg error whose message contains "plant".

## 4. Environment the tests assume

- The tests run as `qualloop_app` (guarded: a connect listener rejects any other role, superuser or BYPASSRLS) and point the app, worker and dispatcher at `qualloop_test` and Redis **database 15** (`tests/conftest.py::_test_env`). The dev stack's workers use database 0 and the dev database, so they never see test jobs.
- Redis URL in `QL_REDIS_URL` must name the ACL user: `redis://qualloop_app:<password>@host:6379/0`.
- Local stand-ins on the usual ports: Postgres, Redis, SeaweedFS `:8333` (`QL_S3_*`), mailpit SMTP `:1025` and REST `:8025` (`QL_MAILPIT_URL` overrides), ClamAV `:3310` (`QL_CLAMAV_HOST`, `QL_CLAMAV_PORT`).
- New third-party packages the tests import (backend adds them to `pyproject.toml`; qa did not edit it): `argon2-cffi`, `dramatiq[redis]`, `boto3` (provides `botocore`), `filetype`, `uuid6`, `apscheduler<4`, `prometheus-client`, `opentelemetry-*`.
- The tests use the API at `https://testserver` so `Secure` cookies are returned by the client.
